summary: Elderly couple's SUV slid off icy County Road 162 into Chalk Creek near Cascade Falls; the couple was trapped in the vehicle and unable to get out; Chaffee County Sheriff's Office, Chaffee County Search and Rescue, Chaffee County Fire Department, Chaffee County Emergency Management, Chaffee County EMS and Colorado State Patrol responded and extracted the couple; neither occupant was injured; the road was closed about two hours while crews worked to extract the occupants and the vehicle
location: Chalk Creek along County Road 162 near Cascade Falls
notes: Freshness sweep 2026-11-22: KRDO (via St. Paul Daily News mirror) + Heart of the Rockies Radio, both parent-opened live; call ~1 p.m. Wed Nov 18; SUV slid off icy CR 162 into Chalk Creek ~4 mi west of Mount Princeton Hot Springs Resort; elderly couple trapped, extracted uninjured; Chaffee County Search and Rescue among responding agencies.
